SELECT grp_code, grp_name FROM tb_code_group
AND (grp_code LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR grp_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')

mapper.update: UPDATE tb_code_group SET grp_name = #{grpName} WHERE grp_code = #{grpCode}
mapper.select: SELECT grp_code, code, code_name, sort_order, use_yn, attr1, attr2, attr3 FROM tb_code WHERE grp_code = #{grpCode} ORDER BY sort_order, code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_code (grp_code, code, code_name, sort_order, use_yn, attr1, attr2, attr3) VALUES (#{grpCode}, #{code}, #{codeName}, #{sortOrder}, COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), #{attr1}, #{attr2}, #{attr3})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_code SET code_name = #{codeName}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, use_yn = #{useYn}, attr1 = #{attr1}, attr2 = #{attr2}, attr3 = #{attr3} WHERE grp_code = #{grpCode} AND code = #{code}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_code WHERE grp_code = #{grpCode} AND code = #{code}
